title: Exact Title Per Type
description: Each kind of event has one specific, documented title — "Shipment booked" should never come back as "shipment booked", "Booking confirmed", or any other near-miss.
successCondition: Book a shipment. After waiting past the queue delay, querying the notifications table via `npm run db:psql` for the newest row belonging to that customer confirms type is exactly the literal string 'shipment.booked' and title is exactly the literal string 'Shipment booked' — matching the events table in docs/api/notifications.md character-for-character, not just approximately.
hints: type and title are both hardcoded string literals passed into the notify() call at the booking call site (apps/api/src/modules/booking/service.ts), not generated or templated dynamically.
Delivery is asynchronous (NOTIFICATION_QUEUE_DELAY_MS, default 500ms per docs/self-host.md) — poll rather than check immediately.
